blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, believed that the Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will conclude toward the end of next month. The former Surigao del Norte representative and governor recalled that the Vice President’s defense panel had asked for a total of 30 days to present its evidence before the prosecution dropped three articles of impeachment against her. However, he said as far as he knew, the defense requested eight trial days on the remaining article on the alleged unexplained wealth of the Vice President and her husband, Manases Carpio. […]...
